title: Choose the visual world for Brett Sabol Plumbing
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned The Display Ad. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll again.

options.label: The Display Ad
options.lineage: The local phone-book display ad and the lawn sign staked at every job
options.thesis: The site is Brett Sabol's directory ad set at full page, and every line in it works.
options.viewport: A directory page: guide words across the top, Brett's boxed ad filling the column with the logo, PLUMBING / HEATING & in heavy type, a reversed 24 HOUR EMERGENCY bar, service bullets and a giant tap-to-call number, with a dot-leader listing column as the navigation.
options.risk: Phone books read nostalgic, and an ad grammar set timidly or crowded looks cheap instead of premium.

raised.raise: Total ink commitment: Sabol blue owns a full third of every screen as solid fields, never a scattered accent.
Colors never blend: yellow, blue, red and black meet as hard edges, no gradients, tints or overlays.
The ad is the packet of the whole site: every bullet in it unfolds into its own page.
Sections stack as separate cut blocks with real gaps, never one endless band of equal sections.
Every action is physically pressable: the call number reads as a hard button and depresses on press.
On phones one block owns the screen at a time, with the call number always one thumb away.

options.label: Mark-Out
options.lineage: PA One Call utility locates: spray-painted lines, stencils and wire flags before a dig
options.thesis: The page is marked out like a yard before a sewer dig, because this crew digs, repairs and restores.
options.viewport: Concrete-gray ground with a blue water line and a green sewer line spray-painted across the fold, stenciled PLUMBING / HEATING / JET DRAIN, a white dig box framing the real excavation photo, and the phone number stenciled inside a red-flagged call button.
options.risk: Locate colors add green to a blue and red brand, and homeowners may read the paint as decoration rather than a code.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: Film editing bench and select rail
options.thesis: Services strung as frames on one perforated rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across the page with frames pinned along it.
options.case: An edit suite means nothing to a homeowner with a backed-up drain. Loses both axes.
options.kept: One ink owns a third of every screen.

options.label: Ebru Bath
options.thesis: Every mark made by moving liquid.
options.viewport: A combed pigment bath filling the frame.
options.case: Swirled water art is decorative and hides the phone number. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Colors displace each other and never blend.

options.label: Miura Sheet
options.thesis: A packet that unfolds into a full field.
options.viewport: A tessellated sheet unfolding from a packet.
options.case: Aerospace origami carries no plumbing truth. Loses both axes.
options.kept: The compact packet unfolds into the whole.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Blocks of weather cut and stacked.
options.viewport: Stacked cloud blocks with blue gaps.
options.case: Dreamlike weather undercuts a practical emergency service. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Sections stack as cut blocks with real gaps.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: A rendered machine around a small video window.
options.viewport: A gray console framing a postcard-size window.
options.case: Retro tech chrome reads as novelty and shrinks the real photos. Loses both axes.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the whole viewport.
options.viewport: A full-screen photo with a glyph rail at right.
options.case: The phone photos are too small to fill a screen, and a feed hides the services. Loses both axes.
options.kept: One block owns the phone screen at a time.
options.risk: Photos too low resolution to carry it.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A premium plumber site the way the category ships it, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Truck photo under a dark overlay, headline and two buttons at left, a badge row, six service cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
